text: {"lessons":["I sold winning positions quickly, but should not let my purchase price or the urge to lock in gains dictate decisions; evaluate each stock’s prospects instead.","Treating each stock as a separate account can hide the risk and performance of my portfolio as a whole, so I should consider the full account when deciding what to hold or sell.","Recent price movements do not predict future returns, so I should avoid frequent trades based only on short-term changes and use a consistent decision process."]}
